## sampling_selection
**299 run(s)** — rule `unselected-PRJNA306542` — (multiple)  
*cross-study determination over the studies' own design statements*

> Determination, not a quotation: for each study below the sampling criterion is stated in the named evidence row, and in none of them is it the presence of disease. PRJNA306542 drought vs well-watered genotype screen (ev-luo2020-design, ev-ma2016-site). PRJNA609211 tillering/maturity stages and an ncRNA arm at the same facility (ev-xia2020t-site, ev-xia2020m-site). PRJNA746402 a maize MAGIC field trial sampled by genotype (ev-cai21b-site). PRJNA383416 a maize diversity panel sampled by genotype and tissue across three settings (ev-krem-field). PRJNA674915/PRJNA915033 grapevine sampled by rootstock, irrigation and phenological stage (ev-har21e-design). PRJNA726716 rice sampled by light and temperature transfer condition (ev-hashida-field). PRJNA510920 rice sampled by nitrogen and water dose at a fixed 49 DAS (ev-swift2019-f16). PRJDB7234 a paddy sampled bihourly for 24 h on sixteen fixed dates (ev-kashima-site). Sampling was therefore driven by genotype, imposed treatment, phenological stage or clock time. Any pathogen present is incidental to why the sample exists, which is the condition the cryptic co-infection hypothesis requires. Contrast disease-selected cohorts, where a plant was sampled BECAUSE it was symptomatic: those are a strong co-infection test set and an unusable prevalence denominator.
